Our story

A New York counter in Antwerp.

Quite Frankly was born from Chantal and Steven's shared dream: a proper American deli, right here in the port city. An open kitchen, a counter to sit at, good music, and sandwiches that need two hands.

Every window is hand-painted. Every pastrami is made in house. No shortcuts.
